name: EPIC 210377172
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 18.1 solar radii and 2.75 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,462 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 2.75 solar masses and 18.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,973 K at its surface.
